source_records.notes: Official Village calendar page on current mokena.gov domain. Calendar view includes municipal meetings, closures, recycling days, election/voting notices, and community events submitted by partner organizations, including Park District events. Individual event detail pages use the MunicipalCMS calendarView.aspx route with a cid query parameter; detail pages expose Event Date, Event Time, Location, and Details. Preserve source provenance and create duplicate candidates rather than silently merging partner events. Listing and detail parsing are implemented offline in scripts/parse_village.py. Terms/robots review and parser verification against saved real HTML are still required; polling remains disabled.

Official Mokena library website links to the LibraryCalendar Upcoming Events page at /events/upcoming. The platform exposes Upcoming, List, Month, Week, and Day views, filters for age group/program type/registration, and event detail pages. Detail pages expose date/time, room, age group, program type, registration state (open/full/waitlist/closed), registration requirements, descriptions, and location/contact details; an event detail explicitly states all times are Central. Featured cards are repeated in the main listing and must not be treated as separate events. Multi-day passive programs and take-and-make windows are valid date ranges; narrative descriptions sometimes mention recurring schedules, which must not be expanded into new events. An individual-event Add to Calendar page was found at /node/{node_id}/add_to_calendar and its Download iCal File link resolves to /node/{node_id}/export.ics; this is event-specific, not a verified combined feed. Library Market product documentation says its calendar can optionally expose RSS/XML/iCal/JSON feeds, but no library-wide feed URL was found on Mokena's public pages. Confirm whether a publisher-wide feed is enabled before designing ingestion. No raw live capture or parser fixture has been created. Terms/robots review remains outstanding; polling disabled.

Official Upcoming Events editorial page. Curated event highlights include dates/times, descriptions, registration links, eligibility, fees, and deadlines. It is not the complete program/class, sports, league, or facility schedule. The public homepage also links to seasonal program brochures (PDF), which are a separate source channel and are not yet supported by the current source-type registry/parser. The separate official Board Information page publishes the Board of Commissioners meeting schedule and is registered as mokena-park-district-board-meetings. Preserve registration details and original event links during extraction. Polling remains disabled pending terms/robots review and a complete, authorized live capture.

Official district Events page exposes a 'Click to Download Calendar' iCalendar export. Apptegy Terms of Use (last updated 2026-09-01, section 3) prohibit automated access using bots, scrapers, or spiders without Apptegy's prior written consent. The feed host robots.txt could not be retrieved during review. Manual network import is controlled by consent_granted. Leave consent_granted=false until written consent is received; set it to true to enable one-shot manual imports. Scheduled polling remains disabled. User-provided local ICS files may still be processed offline. Reviewed 2026-11-03. Official 2026-2027 school-year calendar announcement was located at https://www.mokena159.org/article/2775307 (published 2026-03-19); it links the approved calendar PDF at https://drive.google.com/file/d/10XU79esFWvZ8pJ-IhHGh0w-TVtgkoUdq/view. A user-provided offline ICS export was inspected on 2026-11-04: 5,936 VEVENTs, snapshot coverage begins 2026-11-03, and 17 schedule-focused records are transcribed in data/fixtures/mokena-sd159-2026-27-schedule-exceptions.json. This is not a full-year calendar transcription; August-October 2026 remain outside the snapshot. No live fetch, automated polling, or public publishing was performed. consent_granted remains false. The district's approved 2026-2027 calendar PDF was also retrieved manually from the official Google Drive link on 2026-11-04 and transcribed separately in data/fixtures/mokena-sd159-2026-27-approved-calendar.json. It confirms August 17-18 Teacher Institute Days, August 19 first day, four total institute days, nine early-dismissal dates, 176 student attendance days, five contingency emergency days, and school-specific MJHS e-learning on November 3 and April 6. This manual document review does not grant consent for automated ICS retrieval; consent_granted remains false and polling remains disabled.

Official district Events page exposes a Download .ICS link resolving to this endpoint. The visible default page lists District Events; the page also exposes separate selectable calendars for Indian Trail, Dr. Julian Rogus, Hilda Walker Intermediate, Summit Hill Jr. High, and Mary Drew Early Learning Center. The exact scope returned by id=0 has not yet been verified; treat it as the default district calendar only until compared with school-specific calendar exports. Endpoint responds as text/calendar (web text viewer cannot parse it). Terms/robots review and scope review required before automated retrieval. Discovered 2026-11-03.

Official Mary Drew Early Learning Center Events page on the district's MDELC subdomain exposes Subscribe > Download .ICS, resolving to this endpoint. Its calendar page identifies the site as Mary Drew Early Learning Center and shows a single local calendar named Events. This is a separate school-site calendar endpoint, not the district's default id=0 endpoint. Feed payload has not been inspected; the web reader rejects text/calendar. Terms/robots review and comparison against visible school events required before automated retrieval. Discovered 2026-11-03.

Official Board Information page for the Mokena Community Park District. Lists the 2026 Board of Commissioners meeting schedule, including November 24 and December 15 at 6:00 PM at The Oaks Recreation & Fitness Center. The page also states the normal fourth-Tuesday cadence but shows January and December exceptions in the published 2025 notice; do not extrapolate a 2027 schedule from cadence alone. No live raw capture or parser fixture has been created. Terms/robots review and capture verification remain outstanding; polling disabled.

required_before_polling: Confirm the organization is active and correctly identified.
Find an official website or an explicitly authorized public calendar/feed.
Record the exact event endpoint and source type.
Review applicable terms, robots rules, and rate limits.
Record whether events are public, registration-required, or members-only.
